entries.title: Closing a crewmate's answer closes its task
entries.body: When you ask a question and a crewmate answers it on a note, closing that note now closes the task as answered. Before, the task could stay open after you closed the answer, until the crewmate reported again. Closing a question the crewmate asks along the way still leaves the task open.
entries.noPicture: No screen changes; the task now leaves the open work when you close its answer, as it already did when you chose a button on it.
